messages:
maria: Quick pricing/quotas thread — proposing we add a 24h 'overage forgiveness' (grace window) + per-route throttle caps for streaming endpoints. Want to discuss before Q3 roadmap slot. Short doc: <https://redwood/app/pricing/grace-proposal>

jon: +1 on protecting customers from sudden spikes. Need clear SLOs and UX: how do we show users they're in the grace window vs getting throttled?

samir: From infra POV per-route throttles look doable but require token-level counters on the router. Rough infra cost: ~+6% CPU for tracking and a little more memory. Prefer rolling this to premium/customers first.

lina: Revenue note — a 24h forgiveness will reduce immediate overage revenue. Suggest limited rollout: new accounts + accounts with <$50/month overage history get grace. We can A/B the threshold.

alex: Legal: we should avoid 'forgiveness' in contract text. Recommend 'grace window' and explicit opt-in/opt-out. Also update billing dispute flow.

maria: Agreed on naming — we'll call it 'grace window'. For Dedicated/Committed customers it should be opt-in. UX idea: when throttle triggers return 429 plus header `X-Redwood-Grace: active` and include `Retry-After`. Also push a usage alert email when grace kicks in.

samir: Implementation detail: streaming endpoints need token-level pings. Proposed lightweight usage ping proto snippet: ```json
{"route_id":"chat.stream.v1","tokens":120,"session_id":"abcd1234"}
```
This lets router apply per-route cap without hitting billing downstream every token.

product-bot: RFC created: <https://redwood/rfcs/1835032100-pricing-grace-per-route> :page_facing_up:

jon: OKR callout: add KR — "Reduce customer incidents due to quota spikes by 30%" and metric: percent of requests served under grace vs immediate 429. Also add SLI: time-to-notify user < 5m when grace is used.

lina: Ops TODO: billing needs a `grace_eligible` flag on account and a retroactive credit path for disputes. I'll run a 90-day model and share impact numbers (ETA 5d).

samir: I'll prototype router counters and a config switch to enable per-route caps (ETA 2w). Will post perf numbers.

alex: I'll draft TOS language and the opt-in clause.

maria: Action items recap: Samir prototype (2w), Lina revenue model (5d), Jon OKR wording, Alex TOS draft. If no objections we'll slot this for Q3 roadmap planning sync. :calendar:
